text:
About 26,000 people died from terrorism worldwide in 2017, if perpetrator deaths are counted, as in the Global Terrorism Database figures that Our World in Data uses. My earlier figure of about 18,800 is the Global Terrorism Index count, which leaves out perpetrators. Of the two options on the team note, 26,000 is the only plausible one, since 260 is far too low.

CONFIDENCE: 82
